long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Netanya in a family already established in diamond trading, Beny Steinmetz learned the business before moving to Antwerp after military service. Rather than remain inside his father Rubin's company, he formed a separate diamond venture with his brother Daniel and built supply relationships across southern Africa.

Steinmetz moved upstream from trading into production, acquiring a major South African cutting factory in 1988 and extending operations into Angola and Botswana. He subsequently developed BSG Resources as a wider natural-resources platform, adding mining, metals, energy, capital-markets and real-estate interests. The shift from gems into resource ownership transformed a family-industry advantage into a diversified international business group.
